text:
mira: Short thread to lock a slim alpha for Optimize Toolkit pilots. Need pass/fail bullets by EOD.

sam: Keep it non-destructive: suggestions-only APIs for batching, prefix-cache, quant-report; measurement endpoint for prefix hit estimate; eval-alerts adapter -> webhook/Slack. No auto-apply.

leo: I'll deliver a tiny model-compat table + three-model bench and mark unsafe quant targets.

anya: CS wants: one-line rationale + confidence label on every rec, and a manual accept toggle in the UI/runbook.

ravi: Ops: pilots require canary routing + auto-fallback to hosted model on p95/error SLO breach, plus a one-page rollback runbook.

sam: Example quick smoke: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/suggest -d '{"route":"checkout-chat","seq_len":128,"model":"mx-7b"}' -> returns batching, cache, quant_report, explanation, confidence, measurement_endpoint.

mira: Numeric gates proposal: quality drop <=1.5% on primary metric; token reduction >=10% OR p50 latency improvement >=10% to count as value; alerts default 5% regression.

leo: Quant report must name metric + sample size and include a noise flag if sample small.

anya: CS acceptance checklist: onboarding doc + runbook, 2-week dashboard baseline vs pilot, rollback tested, weekly checkpoints.

sam: Rough ETA if parallel: APIs+measure=3w, quant bench=2w, eval-alert adapter=1.5w, dashboard stub=1.5w -> ~4-5w alpha.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reserved tentative pilot deploy 2024-09-10 02:00 UTC.

mira: Locking minimal alpha to suggestions-only APIs, measurement endpoints, eval-alerts -> webhook/Slack, dashboard stub with manual accept/rollback, runbook. Please react :thumbsup: or list blockers by EOD.
